Before, during, after

One rehearsal. Three useful perspectives.

01 / PLAN

Put the session in order.

Set a date and start time. Add music, breaks, events, and focus notes. Save and duplicate plans for the next rehearsal.

02 / CONDUCT

Adapt as you go.

Follow the countdown and upcoming agenda. Pause, jump, add time, or revise the current duration without losing elapsed time.

03 / REVIEW

See where the time went.

Compare planned and actual time, add a reflection, and share a text or PDF report when it is useful.

Bring your repertoire.
Keep your scores where they are.

Import a forScore metadata CSV to search titles and composers, then add selections to your plan. PodiumPro imports the repertoire information, not the score PDFs or annotations.

Read the import guide

Your rehearsal stays on your device.

No account is required. Plans, repertoire information, and rehearsal records are saved locally. Export or share when you choose; automatic cross-device sync is not included.

Help for your next rehearsal.

The support guide covers imports, live controls, saving, and sharing.
